annotation.authors_or_issuer: 交通运输部、公安部、应急管理部、中国气象局、国家铁路局、中国民用航空局、国家邮政局、中国国家铁路集团有限公司
key_provisions_or_claims: Sets up a 2024 integrated transport Spring Festival travel task force led by the Ministry of Transport
Requires monitoring of passenger and freight flows, capacity deployment and emergency command mechanisms
Requires safety hazard inspections and supervision across rail, road, water, civil aviation and postal sectors
Prioritises transport of key energy and livelihood supplies
Provincial implementation plans must be filed with the Ministry before the travel season starts
annotation.summary_en: Notice from China's Ministry of Transport and partner agencies issuing the 2024 integrated transport Spring Festival travel service and work-safety plan. It covers passenger/freight monitoring, capacity deployment, emergency response, safety inspections and coordination. It has no AI or robotics content.

annotation.title_en: Notice on Issuing the Overall Plan for Integrated Transport Spring Festival Travel Service Assurance and Work Safety 2024
